extracted.name: Black pepper & garlic roasted sweet potatoes
extracted.description: Cook these spiced sweet potato wedges to serve with Rohit Ghai's Kolhapuri spit chicken. They're an easy, satisfying side dish
ingredient_lines: 2 tbsp fresh or dried curry leaves roughly chopped
1kg sweet potatoes scrubbed and cut into wedges
½ small bunch of coriander stalks and leaves separated and roughly chopped
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Mix all the ingredients, except the coriander leaves, together in a large bowl with 1 tsp salt and 2 tsp black pepper.

Arrange the potatoes, skin-side down, on two baking trays or one large, lined with baking parchment if they’re not non-stick, and bake for 30-40 mins until soft inside and crisp on the outside. Season and serve scattered with the coriander leaves.
